entities.name: Apocalypse
entities.description: Third set of the Invasion block, climax of the Weatherlight Saga.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Fights Urza in Yawgmoth's arena, escapes with Urza's head, and does not survive the Weapon's activation.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who led a group to Phyrexia, is decapitated, and asks Gerrard to place his powerstone eyes in Karn.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian lord who revives the loser of the arena fight and arrives for the final battle; his essence is eradicated by the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Golem who becomes a planeswalker after the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Crazed ruler of the Stronghold.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin found broken by Crovax.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member.

entities.name: Grizzlegom
entities.description: Leader of coalition forces fighting to the Stronghold.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Leader of coalition forces fighting to the Stronghold.

entities.name: Lin Sivvi
entities.description: Leader of coalition forces fighting to the Stronghold.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: Dominarian alliance that hurls its might at the Stronghold.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Fortress overlaid onto the swamps of Urborg, held by Crovax.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Swampy land onto which the Stronghold is overlaid.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Yawgmoth's home plane, attacked by Urza.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship whose crew searches the Thran Tome, and which crashes into the ocean with its powers transferred to Karn.

entities.name: Thran Tome
entities.description: Book searched for how the Legacy and the Weatherlight can save Dominaria.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: The completed weapon formed with Karn that eradicates Yawgmoth's essence.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: Moon whose mana Gerrard's allies try to channel into a beam.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane under invasion.

events.summary: Urza leads planeswalkers to Phyrexia, and Gerrard and Urza are forced to fight repeatedly in an arena, revived by Yawgmoth, until Urza is decapitated and Gerrard escapes with the head.
events.quote: Eventually, Urza is decapitated and Gerrard escapes with the head

events.summary: Gerrard lands in the Stronghold throne room where a crazed Crovax stands over Squee.
events.quote: with a crazed Crovax standing over the broken form of Squee

events.summary: Coalition forces fight their way to the Stronghold and battle Crovax's Phyrexian soldiers.
events.quote: fight their way to the Stronghold, where they battle Crovax's Phyrexian soldiers

events.summary: Yawgmoth arrives and the final battle begins; channeling the Null Moon's mana fails to kill him.
Urza has Gerrard place his powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, completing the Legacy; light eradicates Yawgmoth's essence.
events.quote: Light spreads all over the world, eradicating Yawgmoth's essence.

events.summary: Gerrard and Urza die in the Weapon's activation, the Weatherlight crashes, and Karn becomes a planeswalker.
events.quote: Gerrard and Urza do not survive the Weapon's activation

relations.note: Forced to fight each other in an arena
relations.quote: Gerrard and Urza are forced to fight each other in an arena

relations.note: Holds the Stronghold with Phyrexian soldiers
relations.quote: where they battle Crovax's Phyrexian soldiers
